body: {"/properties/advancedQuery/description":"advanced 查询对象。asset_type 对 searchAssetInfo / getExchangeAssetDaily advanced 必填；name 可选；conditions 之间为 AND，单个 condition 中 code 使用 | 分隔多个代码，代表 OR 条件。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/asset_type/description":"advanced 模式资产类型：stock / etf / index；searchAssetInfo / getExchangeAssetDaily advanced 必填，searchIndex advanced 忽略。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/conditions/description":"advanced 条件数组。支持 has_stock；conditions 之间为 AND 关系。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/conditions/items/properties/end_date/description":"日期边界，传 YYYYMMDD 格式的日期字符串；NONE 表示未指定。对 index_component 的 NONE/NONE 默认取最新公告期完整快照，单边 NONE 表示不限制该侧边界。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/conditions/items/properties/index_code/description":"index_component 使用，可用 | 分隔多个指数代码，代表 OR 条件。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/conditions/items/properties/industry_code/description":"sw_industry_l2_component / sw_industry_l3_component 使用，可用 | 分隔多个行业代码，代表 OR 条件。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/conditions/items/properties/max_weight/description":"可选最大权重，取值范围 0.00-1.00。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/conditions/items/properties/min_weight/description":"可选最小权重，取值范围 0.00-1.00。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/conditions/items/properties/start_date/description":"日期边界，传 YYYYMMDD 格式的日期字符串；NONE 表示未指定。对 index_component 的 NONE/NONE 默认取最新公告期完整快照，单边 NONE 表示不限制该侧边界。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/conditions/items/properties/stock_code/description":"has_stock 使用，可用 | 分隔多个股票代码，代表 OR 条件。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/conditions/items/properties/type/description":"index_component / sw_industry_l2_component / sw_industry_l3_component / has_stock。","/properties/advancedQuery/properties/name/description":"可选名称关键词，先走 simple 搜索候选。","/properties/keyword/description":"simple 模式指数关键词，如 沪深300；可用 | 批量。advanced 模式忽略。","/properties/mode/description":"可选：advanced。省略时为 simple。"}
